agents.result_excerpt:
The repair is complete. Summary of the diagnosis and fix:

**Root cause**: The runtime code (`DoorInteractable.Tick`, `DoorInteractionUI.Update`) was already correct — `progressFillImage.fillAmount = door.Progress` runs every frame. The bug was in `DoorPrototypeSceneBuilder.BuildUI`: the progress `Image` was created with `type = Filled` but no `sprite` assigned. Unity's `Image.OnPopulateMesh` silently ignores `fillAmount`/`fillMethod`/`type` and draws a static full rect whenever `sprite == null` — confirmed directly in the checked-in scene YAML (`m_Sprite: {fileID: 0}`, `m_Type: 3`).

**Fix** (`Assets/NoSafeCircle/DoorPrototype/Editor/DoorPrototypeSceneBuilder.cs`): split the progress indicator into a background track and a child "Fill" image, and assigned the built-in `UI/Skin/UISprite.psd` sprite (via `AssetDatabase.GetBuiltinExtraResource`, no external asset) to the fill image so `fillAmount` now has real geometry to animate.

**New automated coverage**: added an Edit Mode test assembly (`Tests/Editor/`) with tests that run the scene builder and assert the fill image has a non-null sprite with correct `Type`/`FillMethod`, plus an idempotency check that rebuilding twice doesn't duplicate the UI element.

`AgentCrew/outputs/implementation_summary.md` now documents the reported defect, diagnosis, fix, new test coverage, and exact human retest steps. Since I can't run the Unity Editor here, the existing on-disk `DoorPrototype.unity` still reflects the old (buggy) config until you rerun **No Safe Circle â†’ Build Door Prototype Scene**.
